अरे भई! बॉलीवुड में दिवाली का खुमार ऐसा छाया कि सितारों ने सुबह पांच बजे तक जमकर पार्टी की! 🪔✨

आयुष्मान खुराना और ताहिरा कश्यप ने हाल ही में मुंबई वाले घर पर दोस्तों और परिवार के लिए ग्रैंड दिवाली पार्टी रखी थी।
ताहिरा के शेयर किए गए वीडियो के मुताबिक, पार्टी में आयुष्मान ने 'बरेली की बर्फी' के को-स्टार राजकुमार राव संग डांस किया और भूमि पेडनेकर ने भी ताहिरा के साथ ठुमके लगाए। 💃🕺
इस पार्टी में करण जौहर, ट्विंकल खन्ना, शिल्पा शेट्टी, मनीष मल्होत्रा, भूषन कुमार, गुनीत मोंगा और अर्जुन कपूर जैसे कई सितारे मौजूद रहे।
ताहिरा का दावा है कि मुंबई अब उनका घर बन चुका है, उनके दोस्त ही उनका परिवार हैं और सबने सुबह 5 बजे तक जमकर डांस किया। 🥳

क्या आपने कभी अपने दोस्तों के साथ सुबह तक दिवाली मनाई है? कमेंट करके बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Ayushmann Khurrana grooves with Rajkummar Rao at Diwali bash; Karan Johar, Bhumi Pednekar join celebrations
ctx.summary: Ayushmann Khurrana and Tahira Kashyap welcomed friends and family to their Mumbai home for a Diwali celebration.
ctx.text:
Ayushmann Khurrana and Tahira Kashyap recently hosted a grand Diwali party for their friends and family members. Several celebrities from the Hindi film industry attended the bash at the actor’s Mumbai residence, including Karan Johar , Sara Ali Khan, Bhumi Pednekar and Rajkummar Rao.
Tahira shared a glimpse of the celebrations on her Instagram account. The video shows Ayushmann dancing with his Bareilly Ki Barfi co-star Rajkummar Rao. The clip also features the couple posing with Karan Johar, Twinkle Khanna, Shilpa Shetty and celebrity designer Manish Malhotra. Bhumi Pednekar was also seen shaking a leg with Tahira.
Meanwhile, Bhushan Kumar, Guneet Monga, Apoorva Mehta, Amar Kaushik, Sara Ali Khan, Akash Kaushik and Arjun Kapoor were among those present at the party. Ayushmann’s brother, Aparshakti Khurrana, and his wife, Aakriti, were also seen dancing their hearts out.
Sharing the video, Tahira wrote, “Let there be love and light Diwali celebrations for @ayushmannk and me have always been with our family and friends! Mumbai has become home, and so our friends are our extended family here! We slept at 5 am and danced till our feet hurt...the best feeling."
A post shared by tahirakashyapkhurrana (@tahirakashyap)
Ayushmann was last seen in Pati Patni Aur Woh Do, which also stars Sara Ali Khan, Wamiqa Gabbi and Rakul Preet Singh. The actor has also reunited with Sara for his latest release, Udta Teer, a spy comedy directed by Aakash A Kaushik.
Udta Teer is a Hindi action comedy directed and written by Aakash A Kaushik, marking his directorial debut. The film stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan in the lead roles, alongside actors including Ram Kapoor, Gulshan Grover, Rahul Bose, Brijendra Kala and Supriya Pilgaonkar.
The film follows a spy caper involving mistaken identity and unexpected twists. Backed by Karan Johar's Dharma Productions and Sikhya Entertainment, it was released in theatres on October 23, 2026.
Ayushmann Khurrana and Tahira Kashyap met when they were teenagers in Chandigarh. The met at a tuition class and they began dating. The couple dated for several years before getting married in 2008, even before Ayushmann made his Bollywood debut with Vicky Donor in 2012.
As Ayushmann pursued his acting ambitions, Tahira stood by him through his early struggles. She later carved out her own career as a writer and filmmaker. The couple share two children, son Virajveer and daughter Varushka.
Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows.

A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today.

At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through film reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, celebrity interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing.
